result_summary.title: Analytics Dashboard data retention and consent issues
result_summary.description: The Analytics Dashboard is not applying retention policies correctly, consent records are missing, and there is a mismatch in data residency flags. This is a high-impact issue for our data governance team. We believe the problem lies within the dashboard's data processing logic. Please investigate why these specific controls are failing.
